runsheet.short_description: On the backstage Zoom client, turn on Original Sound and turn off automatic gain adjustment.
runsheet.more_info: Check this every time --- Zoom settings may reset after updates or re-login.

runsheet.short_description: where T<sub>y</sub> is the start of each remote performance. Remind remote performers: in Zoom audio settings, turn on Original Sound and turn off automatic gain adjustment ("Automatically adjust microphone volume").
runsheet.more_info: Zoom's default audio processing (noise suppression, auto gain) degrades music.

runsheet.short_description: Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but enjoy the performances --- you catch more issues this way. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
Monitor the Webinar and report issues immediately to [#vol-alerts](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CDNPPNJ0Z).
